description: In Year 103161, The Great Unified Imperium successfully annexed colonies of The Consolidated Scientific Systems after a siege on their outer defense platforms.
prose_narrative: A legendary epoch was etched into galactic memory in Year 103161. Tensions erupted as The Great Unified Imperium mobilized millions. Fleets clashed across star systems, burning hyperspace routes and altering alliances. The event stands as the most massive military mobilization ever witnessed.

description: In Year 100937, a joint colony was founded in Capella Nebula by settlers from both The Great Vesperan Imperium and The Great Scientific Imperium.
prose_narrative: A legendary epoch was etched into galactic memory in Year 100937. The galactic stage changed forever as The Great Vesperan Imperium unified sovereign homeworlds under one banner, establishing the first true galactic superpower. Out of local conflicts, order was declared.
